name: @guideshot/schema
description: Portable GuideShot recipe and manifest schemas.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts src/write-schemas.ts src/build-schemas.ts --format esm --dts --clean --sourcemap && node dist/build-schemas.js dist/schemas
scripts.prepack: pnpm run build && test -f dist/index.js && test -f dist/index.d.ts && test -f dist/write-schemas.js && test -f dist/schemas/recipe.schema.json && test -f dist/schemas/manifest.schema.json
